manual_required: Section F (Firefox desktop, Safari iOS 390px) SKIPPED -- Chromium-only coverage explicitly accepted by the site owner for this release (2026-08-02).

SELF-CERTIFIED, no independent reviewer. The mediaverse-qa skill asks for a reviewer separate from the agent that produced the findings; one agent did both here. Three measurement errors were caught and corrected mid-run -- a layout matrix that never set its option, a degradation check that grepped server HTML for client-rendered tabs, and a debug-log read taken while WP_DEBUG was off -- and every one of them initially looked like a pass. An independent re-walk before tagging remains the safer path.

Sections A and B were walked in Docker (wordpress:php8.2-apache + mariadb:11, WP 7.0.2) installing the built release ZIPs, not a working copy. A: 0 fatals, 22 tables Free / 32 with Pro, routes 200 with no manual rewrite flush, 3 pages auto-created, zero debug.log lines. B: real 2.2.1 -> 2.3.0 upgrade, db_version 24 -> 25, all seeded media preserved with privacy and files intact, migration idempotent over two cycles, migration-25 user_archived index back-filled.
Fixed during this cycle and re-verified: F1 soft-404 on every paginated Explore/profile page (95d5406f), F2 no document shell / PHP deprecation on block themes (5f76532a).

F3 OPEN but non-blocking: 7 committed -rtl.css files are never enqueued -- and must not be, because serving them double-flips RTL. Recommend dropping the rtlcss grunt task and deleting the files. RTL rendering itself verified correct on an Arabic install.
Carousel mosaic in the BuddyX Instagram layout was verified by activity counts, image counts and caption presence -- not by eye.

Basecamp #9962498757 ('single media page feels disconnected') should be re-assessed against this build: block themes now render real site navigation on plugin pages for the first time, which was the same root cause.
